Visible text:
Hydraulic power: symbol key

P = ρ g H Q

ρ = fluid density

g = gravitational acceleration

H = head (vertical height difference)

Q = volume flow rate

Visual structure:
A plain white slide with a large dark-gray title at the upper left. Beneath it, a hydraulic-power equation appears on the left, followed by four vertically spaced definitions. No diagram, arrows, axes, or table are present.
